condition: One termination retained effective access for 3 hours against the one-hour lab SLA.
cause: The workflow disabled the IdP but omitted existing role sessions from the access-path join.
impact: A departed worker could still access AWS resources during the gap.
action: Add role-session handling, enforce short privileged sessions and validate every account assignment/native credential path.
retest: Use a synthetic leaver with an active session. Validate denial on each path and final removal within 60 minutes.
closure: Open in baseline; proposed fix and retest plan only. Original period deviation remains in the evidence.

condition: customer-export has a NON_COMPLIANT public-read evaluation.
cause: A migration copied a broad policy and had no post-migration access test.
impact: Customer export data may be externally readable; configuration evidence alone does not establish actual disclosure.
action: Remove the broad grant, enable required blocks, inspect access history and test read/write paths.
retest: Obtain a fresh Config evaluation and an independent negative external-access test with the correct request context.
closure: Open. Accepted risk, if granted, would remain a failing result.

condition: deploy-03 used an approval for an earlier commit; deploy-02 was self-approved.
cause: The release join used PR number instead of immutable deployed SHA, and did not compare actor identities.
impact: Unreviewed changes can reach the production service.
action: Bind approvals to exact SHA, require independent authorized review and close administrator bypass paths.
retest: Seed a post-approval commit and a self-approval; both must fail while an authorized exact-SHA approval passes.
closure: Open. A later successful deployment cannot erase the prior exception.

condition: exercise-02 took 5 hours; exercise-03 recovered data 2 hours behind disruption time.
cause: The recovery procedure omitted startup dependencies and used an insufficient backup schedule.
impact: The service can miss its four-hour recovery or one-hour data-loss objective.
action: Fix the dependency order and backup cadence, then repeat an application-validated exercise.
retest: Measure from disruption start to validated service recovery; validate recovered-data timestamp and cleanup.
closure: Open pending a complete exercise and independent review.

condition: archive bucket evidence is stale; one expected bucket has no Config evaluation.
cause: The team watched job exit status without reconciling the expected bucket population or evaluation age.
impact: Two scoped items have UNKNOWN assurance even if the job succeeds.
action: Add scope reconciliation and observation-age checks with independently scheduled alerts.
retest: Drop an expected record and advance observation age past 24 hours; verify UNKNOWN and escalation.
closure: Open; missing coverage is not treated as compliant.
